content: Hen nanga-anan Jesus hen siguchay finurag hen ihay tagu
Angkay hiyachi way cha manaran cha Jesus, innilacha hen ihay am-ama way nisissigud hen finuragna nanepod hen natatagguwana.
Yag anat hanhanan hen anchichay pasorotna way mangaliyén, “Apo, heno ngata hen fummasor ah gapoh nabfuragan nahhay tagu, ay hiya ono hen chinàcha-arna.”
Yag anat ekat Jesusén, “Faén chillu gapoh fasorna ono fasor hen chinàcha-arna hen nabfuragana, te nabfurag ah mepàil-an hen kafaelan Apudyus an hiya.”

Yachi yag nampani ah Jesus mepanggép hen antoy natatagguwan ya hen matéyan, ekatnéén, “Hen kawad-an hen ag-agaw, yachi hen wayataaw way mangamma hen laychén hen anchi nannag an haén, te no umchah hen lafi, maid kasen wayataaw way mangamman cha nadchi.
Wat hen kawad-à hen antoy lota, haén hen helaw way manelaw hen hamhamà hen katagutagu hen antoy lota.”
Angkay enalen Jesuschi, yag annaat toppaan hen anchi lota yag penelotna yag empalidna hen yachiy petà hen matan hen anchi nabfurag,

yag annaat ifaga way mangaliyén, “In-a ta in-an char-op hen anchi po-ong way Siloe.” (Hen laychén hen anchi ngachan way Siloe way aryénat Nahnag.) Angkay hiyachi way émméy hen anchi nabfurag way i nanchar-op, yag namfangad way naka-anat hen finuragna.
Yachi yag hen anchichay atògongna ya hen anchichay nangila an hiya hen kenapalemmosna, chachan ahepennoot way mangaliyén, “Ay ammoh faénto tà hen anchi tagu way ammag tumutùchu way chan pap-alemmos.”
Yag ekat hen tapenéén, “Hiyan sa met.” Waman hen tapena, ekatchéén, “Faén aya, te an yanggay kapadpachongna.” Yachi yag anat man-ale hen anchi nabfurag way mangaliyén, “Haén kayyà.”
Yag anchaat imohon an hiya way mangaliyén, “Pakay makaila-a ad uwan nò.”

Yag annaat haphapetén way mangaliyén, “Wachan ihay tagu way ah Jesus ano hen ngachanna way annag pen-ar hen petà yag empalidna hen matà ya annaat ifaga ta iyà manchar-op ad Siloe. Yag yachi way émméyà way nanchar-op, ammag naka-anat agé hen finurag-o.”
Yag ekat hen anchichay tataguwén, “Wat chuud kay hen anchi taguwanchi nò.” “Tawwan, te maid innilà,” way ekat agé hen anchi nabfurag.
Hen namistigaran hen anchichay Fariseo hen anchi nabfurag
Angkay hiyachi yag inyéy hen anchichay tatagu hen anchi anat naka-an hen finuragna hen iggaw hen anchichay Fariseo,
te niyaphor way hen nangammaan Jesus an nadchi wat Safachu way siguchay ngilin hen Judio.

Yachi yag anat hanhanan hen anchichay Fariseo no heno hen enkaman hen finuragna way naka-an. Yag annaat ekasen way manaphapet way mangaliyén, “Annag empalid hen petà hen antoy matà, yag angkay inurahà, nakailaa-at agé.”

Yag anat ekat hen tapen anchichay Fariseowén, “Oo a, ngém faén angkay ah Apudyus hen narpowan nahhay tagu, te pakay achina tongparén hen ngilintaaw way Safachu nò.” Yag cha agé ekat hen tapenéén, “Oo a, ngém ay ammoh maka-amma hen menangfasor ah kaskascha-aw way kaman hichi.” Wat ammag nanchuwa hen hamhamàcha.
Yachi yag anchaat ekasen agé way mananhan hen anchi nabfurag way mangaliyén, “Nokay hen manmàno hen yachiy tagu, te annay kena-anna hen finuragno.” Yag ekatnéén, “Profeta manchi.”
Ngém hen anchichay anap-apon hen Judio, anchag achi afuroton way sigud hen finurag hen anchi taguwanchi yag anat makaila ad uwan wat empa-ayagcha hen anchi chinàcha-arna,
yag henanhahanhanancha an chicha way mangaliyén, “Ay tot-owa way yaton anàyu, yag ay tot-owa way nisissigud hen finuragna. Yag pakay makaila ad uwan nò.”
Yachi yag sommongfat hen anchichay chàcha-arna way mangaliyén, “Oo, tot-owa way anànito, ya tot-owa agé way nisissigud hen finuragna.

Ngém hen enkaman hen finuragna way naka-an, yachi hen maid innilani. Ya maid agé innilani no henoh nadchi hen nanga-an. Ngém mafalin kay way sarudsuchunyu an hiya te ommam-ama met, wat érégna way manongfat hen ifagayu.”

Yaha hen enalen hen anchichay chàcha-arna te émégyatcha hen anchichay anap-apon hen Judio, te chicha, loohcha imfafagga way heno way mangaliyén ah Jesus hen anchi Cristu way empopostan Apudyusat meparyaw way meparyaw hen anchi chacha ma-am-amongan.
Wat yachi hen nangaryan hen chinàcha-arnéén egad hiya way somongfat.
Angkay hiyachi yag kasencha agé enayagan hen anchi nabfurag, yag kasencha inimoh an hiya way mangaliyén, “Ah Apudyusat man hen manyamanam, te innilani way ammag menangfasor hen annay taguwanna.”
Yag sommongfat hen anchi nabfurag way mangaliyén, “Maid tot-owa innilà no menangfasorha way tagu ono faén, te hen innilà yanggayat hen pés-éyna, nabfuragà, yag ad uwan, makailaà.”
Yag chachaat agé ekat an hiyéén, “No man paat hen enkamanna way nanga-an hen finuragno aya.”
Yag annaat agé ekatén, “An-og inyam-amma kay way nangimfaga an chàyu yà, yag anyug achi chillu changrén. Yag pakay laychényu agéy kasen mangngar, ono anyu an laychén agé way somorot an hiya.”
Yachi yag ammag ininsorton hen anchichay Fariseo hiya way mangaliyén, “Ammag heaat hen pasorotna yà, te chàniyat ah Moses paat hen chani soroton,
te innilani way tenagépfar paat Apudyus ah Moses. Ngém hen annay taguwannaat, maid ay nailah narpowana.”
Yachi yag sommongfat hen anchi nabfurag way mangaliyén, “Anà ammag nascha-aw a, te tàén chàyuwén maid peet innilayu ah narpowan hen anchi mannakafael way manga-an hen finurag.
Te innilataaw amin met way achi changrén Apudyus hen laweng way tatagu, te hen anchi yanggay manayaw an hiya ya cha mangamma hen laychéna hen changréna.
Yag nanepod hen na-ammaan hen antoy lota inggana ad uwan, maid chengchengngartaaw ah makaka-an hen nisissigud way finurag.
Wat no faén ah Apudyus hen narpowana, maid koma kafaelana way manga-an hen finurag.”

Yag anchaat agég cha ichaggat way manongfat way mangaliyén, “Ay anno cha tudtuchuwan chàni, hea way menangfasor nanepod hen nataguwam.” Yag chachaat eparyaw hiya way maméppég hen hénggépana hen anchi chacha ma-am-amongan.
Hen anchi finurag way faén mata hen nabfurag
Angkay hiyachi way chengngar Jesus hen anchi na-ammaan hen anchi nabfurag, enanapna yag annaat ekatén, “Ay afurotom hen anchi Pangorowan hen Tatagu.”
Yag ekat hen anchi nabfuragén, “Henoh nadchi, Apo, ta omafurotà an hiya.”
Yag ekat Jesusén, “Inni-ilam hiya te hiya hen cha managépfar an hea ad uwananto.”
“Apo wat afurotò hea,” way ekat hen anchi nabfurag an Jesus, yag chinayawna hiya.

Yachi yag entoroy Jesus way mangaliyén, “Hen ummaliyà hen antoy lota, ta uwisê hen tatagu ta hen anchichay kaman nabfurag way manlayad way mangila wat maka-an hen finuragcha yag makailacha. Waman hen anchichay mangaliyén makailacha ano te cha-ancha mabfurag, wat chicha angkay hen nanabfurag.”
Yachi yag hen anchichay tapen hen Fariseo way nehahag-én, hen nangngarancha an nadchi, anchaat ekatén, “Ay ammoh anno ekatén nabfurag-ani.”

Yag sommongfat ah Jesus way mangaliyén, “Non anyu an afunan koma way nabfurag-ayu, achì pafasoron chàyu, te achiayu makaila hen tot-owa ya mafalin way maka-an hen finuragyu. Ngém gapo ta ekatyuwén makaila-ayu, wat é-éttég hen fasoryu way yachi hen namufurag an chàyu.”
